The ULTIMATE Proof of Mahabharata? Lord Krishna's Chariot Marks in Rajgir, Bihar | Chutti Hai Vlog
Unveiling the 5000-Year-Old Mystery of Rajgir! (MUST WATCH)
Step into the world of ancient history and mythology! I traveled to Rajgir, Bihar, to explore the legendary Rath Chakka Chinha (Chariot Wheel Marks)—deep, parallel grooves carved into solid rock, believed to be the immortal tracks of Lord Krishna’s chariot from the Mahabharata era.
